name: University of Wolverhampton

facts.text: The university has four campuses: City and Springfield in Wolverhampton, plus Walsall and Telford.
facts.sourceTitle: Which campus - University of Wolverhampton (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: City Campus is in Wolverhampton city centre and is split into two sites, City Campus Molineux and City Campus Wulfruna.
facts.sourceTitle: Map and directions for City Campus (Wolverhampton) (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Wolverhampton train station is about a 7-minute walk from City Campus and is on the main Birmingham, London, Manchester, Liverpool and Edinburgh lines; the Wolverhampton St George's Metro stop (tram to Birmingham) is also 7 minutes away.
facts.sourceTitle: Map and directions for City Campus (Wolverhampton) (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Walsall Campus is home to sport, teaching and many health-based courses, about half an hour's walk from Walsall train station.
facts.sourceTitle: Map and directions for Walsall Campus (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Telford Campus is an 18-minute walk from Telford Central station.
facts.sourceTitle: Our campus - University of Wolverhampton (search snippet; page not fetched)

sources.title: Admissions Policy and Process 2024-25 - University of Wolverhampton
topics: the applicant's understanding of their chosen course and institution
sources.notes: Not fetched (snippet). Snippet: the purpose of the Pre-CAS Interview is to assess the credibility and genuine study intentions of the applicant and to ensure the University continues to meet its compliance obligations under UKVI sponsor guidance; it may evaluate the applicant's understanding of their chosen course and institution; it may be requested where immigration or credibility risk indicators are identified; it may be required at all levels (UG, PGT, MRes, doctoral); applicants may be asked to attend if requested by Admissions or the Student Visa Compliance & Advice team; missing the interview without a valid reason may result in visa refusal.

Says Wolverhampton requires many international applicants to complete its own Pre-CAS interview after paying an initial deposit and before the CAS is released, and that it is typically a recorded interview; applicants should be ready to show sufficient funds held, where required, for 28 days.
